meta.description: Sino and your specialists help with the work that fills your day, while you stay in charge.

sign_in.title: Welcome back
sign_in.subtitle: Sign in to pick up where you left off with Sino.
sign_in.bad_credentials: That email and password don't match. Try again.

sign_up.title: Meet Sino
sign_up.subtitle: Create your account. Sino and the specialists are ready when you are.
sign_up.consent: I agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.
sign_up.consent_required: Please agree to the terms to continue.
sign_up.marketing: Send me product news now and then. You can stop any time.
sign_up.sent: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to verify your email, then sign in.

forgot_password.title: Forgot your password?
forgot_password.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new one.
forgot_password.sent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.

reset_password.title: Set a new password
reset_password.subtitle: Pick something you don't use anywhere else.
reset_password.incomplete: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
reset_password.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
reset_password.done: Your password is changed. Other devices were signed out.

verify_email.title: Verify your email
verify_email.verified: Your email is verified. You're all set.
verify_email.failed: This link has expired or was already used. Sign in and we'll send you a new one.

oauth_errors.access_denied: Sign-in was cancelled. Try again, or use your email.
oauth_errors.link_expired: That sign-in link expired. Try again.
oauth_errors.email_not_verified: Your account with that provider has no verified email. Verify it there, or sign up with email.
oauth_errors.generic: We couldn't sign you in with that account. Try again, or use your email.

orbit.headline: Your team is already at work.
orbit.line: Sino and six specialists handle the busywork. You stay in charge of what goes out.

lineup.headline: Meet your new team.
lineup.line: Six specialists, one companion. Create your account and they start today.

mail.headline: A reset link is on its way.
mail.line: Sino delivers it to your inbox. It works for 30 minutes.

build.headline: Almost back in.
build.line: Pick a new password and Sino signs you out everywhere else, to be safe.

thumbs.headline: One tap and you are in.
thumbs.line: Verifying your email keeps your workspace yours.

ticker.sinofinance: matches invoices to your bank statement
ticker.sinosales: drafts the follow-up after a client call
ticker.sinosocial: plans next week’s posts in your brand voice
ticker.sinopeople: turns a job brief into a ready posting
ticker.sinoinsights: spots what changed in this month’s numbers

profile.full_name_helper: As it appears on your documents. 2 to 100 characters.
profile.preferred_name_helper: What Sino should call you. Leave empty to use your first name.
profile.salutation_helper: Used with your name, for example Kak Faishal.
profile.about_me_helper: A line or two about you and your work. Sino can use it to answer better.
profile.use_context_helper: Share your name, form of address, language and these notes with Sino. Never your email, phone or photo.
profile.email_helper: Your sign-in email. It cannot be changed here yet.
profile.phone_helper: Optional. We save it as +62..., for example 0812 3456 7890 becomes +6281234567890.
profile.language_helper: The language of the app. Sino's replies follow your messages.
profile.time_zone_helper: Used for dates, times and schedules.
profile.job_title_helper: Shown to the people in this workspace.

errors.name_chars: Use letters, spaces, apostrophes, periods or hyphens only.
errors.phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number, for example 0812 3456 7890.

preferences.theme_helper: Saved to your account, so your other devices follow.
preferences.density_helper: How much room lists and rows take.
preferences.reduce_motion_helper: Less movement across the app. Your system setting is always respected.
preferences.focus_mode_helper: A plain background in Rooms, with no character.
preferences.room_view: Room view in chats with Sino
preferences.room_view_helper: Show the Room of the specialist who answered.

inbox.label: Inbox
inbox.blurb: Drafts waiting for your OK, and updates from your specialists, in one place.

customers.label: Customer chats
customers.blurb: See every chat your customers send on WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook. SinoHelp drafts the replies, and you can take over any chat yourself.

squads.label: Squads
squads.blurb: Put specialists together as a squad that works on one goal.

library.label: Sino Library
library.blurb: Your files and notes, so Sino answers with what your business already knows.

tools.label: Connected tools
tools.blurb: Connect the tools you already use so specialists can work inside them.

workflows.label: Workflows
workflows.blurb: Chain steps across specialists and tools, with your approval where it matters.

routines.label: Routines
routines.blurb: Jobs that run on a schedule, like a Monday sales recap.

skills.label: Skills
skills.blurb: Teach a specialist how your business does a task, once.

onboarding_ui.create_description: Create a workspace for your business. If you were invited, use the invitation link instead.

onboarding_ui.channels_hint: Add your business links. You can review website suggestions later in Business Profile.

business_ui.description: Confirm the business details Sino may use. Every save keeps a version you can restore.
business_ui.samples_hint: One sample per line. Up to three samples, each at most 500 characters.

business_ui.price_hint: Enter a price only if you want it included. Sino never guesses prices.

business_ui.unconfirmed: Not confirmed. Sino will not use this entry yet.
